name: Label Sheet
summary: A site where every product is shown the way its package label reads: thick ink borders on warm paper, big numerals, a radial data wheel on a deep green poster. Built for regulated or claims-heavy retail where the label is the trust. Unknown facts are marked Sample, never invented.

for: retail of regulated goods (cannabis, supplements, food, cosmetics) where a label is the honest part
sites built before the real business facts exist
menus and catalogues driven from a data file
not_for: pages with no structured data to show

type.display: Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, serif
type.text: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

shape.note: labels have 6px corners and 3px ink borders with a hard offset shadow; buttons and chips are pills; no blur, no gradients

signature.name: the wheel and the label
signature.rule: A large radial wheel (one numbered wedge per data item, length proportional to its value on one scale shared by every product) beside a very large serif headline on deep green; below, product cards laid out as labels: category line, name, two boxed key numbers, bars on the same scale, then test date, lab, batch and report.
signature.carries: the product's real composition, with the scale stated on the page

motifs.use: any content that is not yet real
motifs.rule: A dashed 'Sample' mark (rule style plus a word), 'sample' in place of any date, lab or batch, and the word inside the graphic itself, so a screenshot cannot pass it off as data.
Every wheel and bar on the site uses the same scale, stated beside the chart.

motifs.use: explaining a label or a diagram
motifs.rule: Numbered 44px badges on a sample label, each linking to its section of the guide; numbers, not colour, carry the mapping.
The build refuses a real item with a placeholder lab, batch or report reference, a bad or future date, an out-of-range number, or no licence number.

never: claiming on a page what the data cannot back (every-product-is-labelled copy while the items are samples)
a plausible-looking date, lab or number on a sample item
bars or wheels on different scales shown side by side
colour as the only link between a wedge and its name
unbroken user text that can scroll the page sideways (set overflow-wrap)

provenance.source_run: SolutionsAsService/CannabisCo, Adaptive Full run bounded to one panel round (Arnheim, Krug, Debord, Cairo) plus one owner-requested improvement; see its DESIGN-LOG.md
measured: Mobile Floor 12 of 12 on all four pages at 360, 390 and 430px
contrast pairs all at or above 5.6:1 (Cairo)
a 120-character unbroken product name causes no sideways scroll at 360, 390 or 430px
open: one panel round; S1 and S2 not met
no legal reviewer; age verification is a notice only
general statements in the guide from general knowledge, not cited
not shown on a real phone
